name: Copilot & AI
description: Turn off Copilot, Recall, Click to Do and the AI features in Edge, Paint and Notepad.

tweaks.name: Turn off Windows Copilot
tweaks.summary: Turns off the Copilot sidebar by policy and hides the taskbar button.
tweaks.description: Sets the Turn off Windows Copilot policy for this user and the PC and hides the Copilot taskbar button. The older built-in Copilot follows this policy. The newer Copilot app does not, so also tick Remove the Copilot app.

tweaks.name: Remove the Copilot app
tweaks.summary: Uninstalls the Copilot app for all users.
tweaks.description: Removes the Copilot app packages for every user and for new accounts. The Copilot key on new keyboards then opens search or does nothing.

tweaks.name: Disable Recall
tweaks.summary: Stops Recall from taking snapshots of your screen and removes it.
tweaks.description: Recall saves snapshots of your screen so you can search them later. This turns off snapshots for every user and tells Windows to remove the Recall feature. Only Copilot+ PCs have Recall. On other PCs this changes nothing you can see.
tweaks.goodToKnow: After undo, you may need to add Recall back in Settings > System > Optional features or Windows Features.

tweaks.name: Disable Click to Do
tweaks.summary: Turns off the AI actions overlay on Copilot+ PCs.
tweaks.description: Click to Do looks at what is on your screen and offers AI actions for text and images. This turns it off for every user. Only Copilot+ PCs have it.

tweaks.name: Turn off Copilot in Microsoft Edge
tweaks.summary: Hides the Copilot sidebar in Edge and stops it reading pages.
tweaks.description: Sets Edge policies that turn off the sidebar (where Copilot lives), stop Copilot from reading the page you are on, and turn off the Compose writing helper.
tweaks.goodToKnow: Edge will show "Your browser is managed by your organization". That is how Edge shows any policy.

tweaks.name: Turn off AI in Paint
tweaks.summary: Turns off Cocreator, Image Creator, generative fill and generative erase.
tweaks.description: Sets Paint policies that turn off its AI image features. Normal drawing and editing are not affected.

tweaks.name: Turn off AI in Notepad
tweaks.summary: Turns off Rewrite, Summarize and other AI features in Notepad.
tweaks.description: Sets the Notepad policy that turns off its AI features. Notepad works as a plain text editor.
